📜 Update Log

November 18, 2026
  • Desktop app: fixed the error box "net::ERR_NETWORK_IO_SUSPENDED" that could pop up after waking your laptop from sleep. A failed update check is now ignored, and the app checks for updates again after it wakes up.
  • No more menu lag: the animated menu background is now a short looping video of the battle (one for each theme) instead of being drawn live, so it costs almost nothing to play. The title intro is still drawn live. If you turn off "Animated menu background" in Settings you get the still picture as before.
  • Less lag in the shop: the animated menu background used to keep drawing a whole battle behind the shop even though you could not see it. It now pauses while the shop is open, and the parts of the menu scene that never move (sky, hills, dark edges) are drawn once instead of every frame.
  • The Angry Teacher now has angry eyebrows.
  • The Support Teacher only shows up in the main menu background when you have bought and equipped the Support Teacher buff.
  • NEW skins: Old 1 and Old 2 for the Wise Sheikh (300 💚 each, double a normal skin). They are his two very first looks. Both throw his old blue orbs and he does not lean when he throws. Find them in the shop's Skins tab (Sporty, Modern & Special board).
  • New head shapes for the Mathematician (a taller rounded head, with his old face, Minecraft-Steve-style hair (thin top, short square sides) and beard and the same ponytail, and the beard hair now climbs up the sides of his face like Wise Sheikh's) and Tech Savvy (a rounder, wider head with a thick black hair frame around his face), based on the doodles.
November 16, 2026
  • Removed the last leftovers of the game's old name: it is just Unity Defense everywhere you can see it now (the first-version log line, the desktop app's internal file name, the website).
  • NEW Teacher Buff: 🤝 Support Teacher for the Angry Teacher (shop → Upgrades → Teachers, 1000 💚, level 20). A teacher in a green shirt with white buttons and a green collar stands beside every Angry Teacher, and her Negative now does 3x damage instead of 2.5x. You can wear it together with Whistle. Equip it in your profile → Buffs. He is also standing next to the Angry Teacher in the main menu background.
  • Tech Savvy beard update: his beard is now faded (see-through, so his skin shows through a little), and his moustache leaves a gap above the beard and only connects at the ends.
  • His Safety Glasses are white.
November 15, 2026
  • NEW teacher on The Quad: 🔧 Tech Savvy. Black shirt, light skin, short black blocky hair, a moustache and a short beard that climbs up the sides of his face in two little triangles. Hire him in the shop (wave 15+) for 358 🪙, then each one costs 247 🪙 (max 5). He is Quad only, like the Arabic Expert.
  • Cracka! (his attack): every 10 seconds a crack opens in the ground in front of the kebab closest to the school and stays open for 5 seconds. Every kebab that walks over it has a 1 in 5 chance to fall in and is defeated (a boss only loses 20% of its health).
  • Racecar ultimate (no voice line): it takes him 2.5 seconds to set up a little wooden CO2 racecar, then it drives at the kebab nearest the school, 0.5 faster than that kebab, and explodes on it for 50% of its health (a kebab under half health is defeated). Two cars never chase the same kebab. If anything else happens to the kebab first (it reaches the school, gets pulled, sits on the floor, dies), the car just explodes for no damage.
  • NEW skin: Safety Glasses for Tech Savvy (main menu shop → Skins). He is also in the main menu background battle now.
  • NEW theme: Christmas 🎄 (Settings → Theme). A snowy white field with a red school, Christmas trees, snowmen and presents, snow falling over the map and in the menu scene, red and green menus and floating decorations.
  • The teacher panel now scrolls when you have more than a few teachers unlocked. The Controls box is now collapsed by default (click its title to open it) to give the teachers room.
  • Removed the blank green patch under the field: the field is now exactly as tall as the map.
  • The big BOSS KEBAB INCOMING! / THE TRACK SPLITS! / THREE TRACKS! texts next to the Kebab Man in the cutscenes are gone. He just talks now.
  • Fix: the Kebab Man cutscenes (boss, split track, tri-track) were squashed after the field got shorter. They are the right shape again.
November 14, 2026
  • Teacher placement: click a teacher and they stick to your mouse (letting go doesn't place them), click the map to place, click the teacher panel to put them back. Holding and dragging still works.
  • NEW: Beam Clash cutscene. If Tuff Sheikh and BOYS have their ultimates active at the same time, they fire at each other and clash in an 18 second cutscene with music (the beams fire on the song's first hit). The song's credits are in the main Credits menu. It plays for both players in Online Mode and can be turned off in Settings.
  • Fix: BOYS's ultimate keeps its lightning and starburst even in low-effects mode (the game switches to low effects by itself when it lags, which used to strip them).
  • TestAccount1 now has admin access (admin characters, admin tools, no level locks). BOYS's pink aura now pulses faster when her ultimate is ready.
  • Performance: the hidden battle is no longer drawn behind the menu, and the Play button shine now runs on the GPU. Nothing looks different.
November 12, 2026
  • Smoother main menu: the game no longer draws the hidden battle behind the main menu (the menu has its own animated scene), so the menu runs faster.
  • New admin character: BOYS (only the admin account can place her, free, max 3, in every mode, not in the menu background): the default Angry Teacher with pink flame eyes and a pink aura that pulses when her ultimate is ready. Her attack, Suspension, takes 50% of a kebab's health and sends it back to the start of the track. Her ultimate BOYSSSSSSS: the screen goes dark while she channels and breathes in, then a huge pink shockwave pulses 6 times over 5 seconds (turbulent plasma smoke, forking lightning that crawls over the rings, a white-hot starburst core, beads of light, flying rocks and debris), shaking the screen, each pulse doing massive damage. Equip / Unequip her in the Admin screen.
  • The game is now a Release: the version in the top left says v1.0.32 Release instead of Alpha.
  • Intro sounds: every title letter now makes a little thunk when it lands, and after the shine sweeps over the letters the REMASTERED logo slams in with its own sound, then the buttons fade in.
  • Arabic Expert's shirt fixed: the blue checks used to stay fixed on the screen while he moved (like a green screen). They now move with him.
  • Angry Teacher's new look: she now wears a black leather coat and a scarf with a tie-dye texture (the end of it hangs down her chest).
  • New skin: Twin for Angry Teacher (150 💚): her old look, the brown leather coat and pink scarf. Find it in the shop's Skins tab (Sporty, Modern & Special board).
November 10, 2026
  • New placing system: each teacher button is now a picture of the teacher with the name above and the cost below. Hold a teacher and drag them onto the map: they follow your mouse as a faded, wriggling picture and the tile under them lights up yellow. Let go and they drop onto the tile with a squishy bounce. To cancel, drag them back over the teacher panel (or press Esc).
  • Arabic Expert's Uniform Check is now animated (about 3 seconds): he swooshes 5 random kebabs up to him, each one gets a quick uniform scan (there is no real uniform), then one random kebab of the five is expelled and launched away. The other four go to the second track.
  • Custom cursor: the mouse pointer is now a pixel-art white glove (a pointing hand, closing into a fist when you click or hold a teacher). New Custom cursor setting turns it off.
  • Click animation: clicking makes a white ping circle and the glove looks like it is clicking (the finger presses down).
  • Wind sound: the wind whoosh now only plays on big menu screens (main menu, account, updates, credits...). It no longer plays for Friends, Inbox, Settings or Admin.
  • Placing: the teacher you carry is now part of the mouse pointer (a fist holding them), so it can no longer lag behind, and it sways with the way you move the mouse.
  • Game intro: the title letters are no longer italic.
  • Guide, Guide Mode, tutorial and the Controls list explain the new placing.
November 9, 2026
  • Game intro reworked: the characters are now placed one by one on the menu field, then the title letters fly in from all around, then the buttons fade in.
  • Suspensions: pressing OK on the suspended screen now ends any running battle and reloads the game, so the wave and placed teachers can't be continued. The suspension is also remembered on the device, so a suspended player is blocked straight away after reopening the game.
November 8, 2026
  • 🚫 Suspensions (admin): the admin can suspend a Google-linked account for any number of days (editable) with a reason, and lift it again. A suspended player sees the reason and the end date and cannot play until it ends.
  • Mathematician: his ultimate now also builds up by shushing: every kebab he shushes fills 2%.
  • Arabic Expert (Uniform Check buff): his ultimate also gains 5% every time he tucks kebabs in, on top of the slow 75 second charge.
  • Wise Sheikh: his ultimate gains +10% every wave you clear, and still fills from killing blows.
  • Save & quit: after loading a saved battle you cannot heal teachers and their ultimates cannot charge until you beat 1 wave.
  • Autoclicker detector improved: it now catches clickers set anywhere from 0 to 100 ms (16+ clicks in a second, or an average gap under 100 ms over 20 clicks), and click damage can never exceed 11 hits a second.
  • Quad kebabs: the Soccer Kebab's ball and the OZ Tag Kebab's ribbons are back. The Kebab Man no longer wears or juggles any soccer gear on the Quad (no football, whistle or yellow card).
  • Skins: in the Customize tab you can now pick your profile picture's skin and, separately, the skin of each placed teacher in battle. The two no longer affect each other.
  • Game intro: the title-letters intro stays (it was briefly removed by mistake).
  • Scrolling fixed: the Admin Panel (player list), the How to Play pop-up, the profile, settings, inbox and chat screens and other pop-ups now scroll when the window is small, so nothing is cut off or out of reach.
  • Better rewards on newer maps: The Quad pays ×1.5 XP and Positives (and each future map pays 0.5 more than the one before). Once you have unlocked a newer map, the older maps slowly pay less: -0.2% for every wave you clear on them, down to 40%. The map select shows each map's multiplier.
  • Angry Teacher: her old internal name was removed from the whole game. Saves, skins, buffs and friends' profiles that used it are converted automatically.
  • Guides updated: Teacher Health & Healing, All Teachers at a Glance, Wise Sheikh, Mathematician, Arabic Expert, Skins, Profile & Customizing, Fair Play and the Quad kebabs.
November 7, 2026
  • Wise Sheikh: his SHEBAB ultimate is back to 30% of a kebab's current health (the 15% nerf from November 6 is undone).
  • Hitter kebabs: a steady 1 in 5 kebabs on every wave (they no longer get rarer as waves go on).
  • Everything is 35% cheaper: hiring and placing every teacher, and all the in-battle shop upgrades (damage, speed, click power, health, medic, mega, more teachers).
  • New buff: 🪪 Uniform Check for the Arabic Expert (1000 💚, level 20). It gives him a slow-charging ultimate: he checks the uniform of 5 random kebabs, each has a 25% chance to be expelled, and the rest are sent to the second track.
  • Guides updated: Hitter Kebabs, Arabic Expert, Teacher Buffs, All Teachers at a Glance and the price tables.
November 6, 2026

  • Wise Sheikh: his SHEBAB ultimate now takes 15% of a kebab's current health (was 30%).

  • 🏆 Leaderboard: now lists every player with a Google-linked account (no need to re-save), and the top 3 wear a 👑 crown.
  • Autoclicker detector: autoclickers and script clicks are caught and click damage is switched off for a while. Playing normally is never affected.

  • New: Welcome Guide: the first time you open the game, a short slideshow with pictures explains the things new players ask about: accounts (and linking Google), Positives and the main menu Shop, 🎁 daily rewards, the shop that opens in battle, levels and maps, friends and Online Mode, and where to find help.   • Replay the Welcome Guide any time with 👋 Welcome Guide at the bottom of the main menu, or the Replay button in Settings.

  • New: 🏆 Leaderboard: most waves survived and most 💚 Positives. Only accounts linked to Google are ranked, and the admin is not. Button at the top right of the main menu.

  • Mathematician buff: Algebra Swarm now hits for 45% of a kebab's health (was 35%).

  • Teachers in the first shop: on the School Grounds and the Quad you can now hire any teacher (Mathematician, Angry Teacher or Arabic Expert) from the first shop at wave 15. You still buy one thing per shop.

  • Admin characters: the Admin screen has a new card to Equip / Unequip admin characters like Tuff Sheikh.
  • Guides updated: the All You Need to Know guide and the Guide Mode tips now cover all of the above.
  • Tuff Sheikh update: he no longer shows in the main menu background (admin characters never will), and the admin can now use him everywhere: normal map, Quad, Test Mode and Online Mode (Team Up and VS). He is always free.
  • New admin character: Tuff Sheikh (only the admin account can place him): Wise Sheikh with glowing red eyes. He does not attack, his red ultimate fills by itself, and when you click it he shouts SHEBABBBB and for 5 seconds lasers shoot out of his eyes that follow your mouse and one-shot everything. He is free to place (max 3) and works in every mode, including Online Mode.
  • New skin: Modern for the Mathematician (150 💚): a blue shirt with a folded collar and white buttons. Find it in the shop's Skins tab (Sporty, Modern & Special board).

November 2, 2026

October 31, 2026
  • Boss, split-track and tri-track cutscenes upgraded too: bigger title slams, the boss bursts out of the shop, and the new track cracks open along its path before it appears.

  • 📖 How to Play for Online Mode: under Team Up and under VS there is now a How to play button. It is a slideshow with pictures and text (like the old tips screen). At the end it asks "Would you like to turn on guide mode for this gamemode?"

Team Up covers the two maps, shared coins, free Wise Sheikhs, the chat, the bot's moves list, split and tri tracks and bosses. VS covers turns, tracks, sending teachers, defending, income and upgrades. Each mode has its own switch in Settings.

  • Tracks now grow like the normal game: one track, then the split track at wave 10, then the tri-track at wave 40, each with its cutscene and track reveal. Kebabs walk both maps

  • 💬 Chat with your friend while you play, in the panel under How to Play. Playing a bot? The same box lets you tell the bot what to do (save coins, top map, near the school, use ults, status...)
  • 🤖 Bot moves panel: lists everything the bot does and the total coins it has spent. The bot now really spends the shared coins (you see them go down), heals, uses ultimates and buys one shop upgrade per shop

⚙️ Settings

Graphics qualityLow turns off shake, hit flash, waddling and teacher animations and trims particles - best for slower computers.
Auto low-effects when laggingSwitches to Low by itself if the game runs slowly for a few seconds.
VSyncOn = drawing is synced to your monitor's refresh rate (smoothest, 60/120/144 FPS and so on). Off = a timer drives the game at the Max FPS below. Browsers can't draw faster than the monitor shows.
Max FPSGameplay speed never changes - this only limits how often the game is drawn. Unlimited = as fast as your monitor goes (about 240 with VSync off).
Field of view (zoom)Smaller = zoom out and see more screen, bigger = zoom in.
100%
ThemeChanges the look of the map and menus.
Volume
100%
Max sounds at onceStops loud pile-ups when lots of teachers attack together.
Sound effects
Button & menu soundsA click when you press buttons, and a soft wind when big menu screens switch (not Friends, Inbox or Settings).
Shop musicThe shop theme song plays while a shop is open. It follows the Volume slider.
Level-up pop-ups
Screen shake
Animated menu backgroundTeachers fight kebabs on the map behind the main menu. Off = a still picture (saves power).
Custom cursorReplaces the mouse pointer with a pixel-art white glove (the finger presses down when you click, with a white ping circle). While you carry a teacher they are part of the pointer, hanging from a fist, and sway as you move the mouse. Off = your normal pointer.
Game intro animationWhen you first open the game, the teachers are placed one by one, the title letters fly in and the buttons fade in. Plays once per visit.
Guide ModeThe game follows along and circles and points at things: the basics and controls first, then every new teacher and upgrade. Also on the ❓ How to Play button in a battle.
Guide Mode: Team UpPoints things out during Team Up matches (two maps, shared coins, chat, the bot panel, tracks and bosses). It also gets offered at the end of the Team Up how-to-play.
Guide Mode: VSPoints things out during VS duels (turns, tracks, sending teachers, defending and upgrades). It also gets offered at the end of the VS how-to-play.
Event pop-upsPop-ups at the bottom for the next boss, split track, tri-track and shop.
Skip intro animationTurn on to skip the kebab shop cutscenes before the split track, tri-track and boss kebabs.
Beam clash cutsceneThe cutscene that plays when Tuff Sheikh and BOYS use their ultimates at the same time (admin only).
Teacher animationsBlinking, eye movement and teachers chatting with their neighbours.
Kebab health bars
Show FPS counter
Keep running in the backgroundThe game keeps going when you switch tabs or minimise.
Welcome guideThe short slideshow about accounts, the shops, daily rewards, levels and friends. It shows the first time you open the game.
